title: Germany – Refuse and waste related services – Transport von Restabfällen und Sperrmüll aus dem Ennepe-Ruhr-Kreis ab dem 01.01.2027
description: Gegenstand der Leistung ist der Transport von Restabfällen und Sperrmüll, die dem Ennepe-Ruhr-Kreis als öffentlich-rechtlicher Entsorgungsträger überlassen werden, ab dem 01.01.2027. Die Leistung umfasst jeweils die Übernahme von den zwei Übernahmestellen im Kreisgebiet und den Transport zur jeweiligen Verwertungsanlage. Die Leistung ist unterteilt in zwei Lose: Los 1 umfasst die Übernahme und Transport von Restabfällen. Die erwartete Abfallmenge an Restabfall ab der Umschlagsanlage im Nordkreis (Übernahmestelle Witten) beträgt 28.900 Mg/a, ab der Umschlagsanlage im Südkreis (Übernahmestelle Gevelsberg) 19.900 Mg/a. Los 2 umfasst die Übernahme und den Transport von Sperrmüll. Die erwartete Abfallmenge an Sperrmüll ab der Umschlagsanlage im Nordkreis (Übernahmestelle Witten) beträgt 8.000 Mg/a, ab der Umschlagsanlage im Südkreis (Übernahmestelle Gevelsberg) 5.700 Mg/a. Die Einzelheiten des Leistungsumfangs sind in der Leistungsbeschreibung (Kapitel II.) festgelegt.

title: Ireland – Architectural, construction, engineering and inspection services – Doneraile Weirs Barrier Mitigation Project
description: Inland Fisheries Ireland is seeking to procure multidisciplinary consultancy services to assist with the delivery of a Barrier Mitigation Project, Doneraile Weirs on the Awbeg River in Doneraile, Co. Cork, through the completion of Phases 1 to 3. The appointed Consultant will undertake all necessary engineering, environmental and planning services required to progress the project through feasibility, option selection, and statutory consent stages in accordance with the Planning and Development Acts 2000–2023, the Capital Works Management Framework, and Infrastructure Guidelines 2023. The Barrier Mitigation Project aims to mitigate the impacts of the identified barriers on fish passage and restore more natural river processes along the associated rivers. The commission forms a specific action under Ireland’s Water Action Plan 2024 and supports implementation of the National Barrier Mitigation Programme to deliver improved ecological status under the EU Water Framework Directive. The Consultant will act as the Designer, Project Supervisor Design Process during all Phases of the project and carry out all related necessary duties.

title: WorkWell Service for NHS Essex ICB
description:
NHS Essex Integrated Care Board (herein referred to as the Authority) seeks suitable providers for this WorkWell Services as defined by the LOT structure and service specific details outlined in Document 3a and Document 3b Service Specifications. There is one (1) Essex Work and Health Coach Service, with four (4) separate placed-based Work and Health Partnership Services.

The Authority is undertaking a Competitive Process under the PSR 23 with the aim to secure the most suitable Provider for the provision of ‘Essex WorkWell Neighbourhood Work and Health Coach Service’ and ‘Local WorkWell (Work & Health) Partnership(s)’. The Authority aims to award a single contract for each service to a single Provider (either as the sole Provider or as the ‘Lead Provider’ on behalf of a consortium). These services support the Authority’s WorkWell offering in Essex. Suitable organisations, SMEs and Local Providers are invited to tender for these services and can submit a compliant bid for one or all LOTs.

Lot 1: Essex WorkWell Neighbourhood Work and Health Coach Service
Lot 2: Local WorkWell (Work & Health) Partnership - Mid and North Essex (MNE)
Lot 3: Local WorkWell (Work & Health) Partnership - West Essex (WE)
Lot 4: Local WorkWell (Work & Health) Partnership - South East Essex (SEE)
Lot 5: Local WorkWell (Work & Health) Partnership - South West Essex (SWE)

The aggregate value of the Proposed Contract (including extensions and any available options excisable during the term of the Proposed Contract) across all five (5) LOTS as advertised in the Central Digital Platform (CDP) also referred to as Find a Tender Service (FTS), is £5,163,141.00.

The proposed contract duration is from 01/12/2026 to 31/03/2029.

The Proposed Contract to be entered into by the Authority and the Preferred Bidder(s) for the Services will be based on the NHS Standard Contract 2026/27 (full-length) and all subsequent variations thereof from time to time during the contract term.

All details related to this opportunity, including the procurement documentation are in the Atamis portal - please register and apply via Atamis e-sourcing portal https://health-family.force.com/s/Welcome
The relevant documentation will be available within the “C460866 WorkWell Services” project.

It is free to register on the Atamis portal and it can be accessed at any time of day providing you have a working internet connection. Should providers have any queries, or are having problems registering on the portal; they should contact the Atamis helpdesk via: Support-health@Atamis.co.uk or phone number 0800 9956035. The helpdesk is open Monday - Friday between 08:00 - 18:00

The deadline for tender submissions is 12:noon on the 15th September 2026.

title: Omnicell Occ Health
description: Omnicell Occ Health for St. Cloud VA Health Care System. This is a combined synopsis/solicitation for commercial items prepared in accordance with the format in FAR Subpart 12.6, as supplemented with additional information included in this notice. The solicitation document and incorporated provisions and clauses are those in effect through Federal Acquisition Circular (FAC) 2026-08. This procurement is SDVOSB set-aside. Prospective offerors must be registered and current in the System for Award Management (SAM) database at time of offer to the Government (https://www.sam.gov). Quotes will only be accepted from responsible contractors. The NAICS code for the solicitation is 339112 with a size standard of 1,000 employees. A list of the contract line items, quantities, and units of measure are listed within the attached solicitation documentation. The VA anticipates one firm fixed price contract award to provide services to St. Cloud VA Health Care System, 4801 Veterans Drive, St. Cloud, MN 56303 St. Cloud VA Health Care System, 4801 Veterans Drive, St. Cloud, MN 56303. The period of performance is 09-15-2026 to 09-30-2026. FAR provisions 52.212-1, 52.212-2, and 52.212-3 apply to this procurement and are detailed within the attached solicitation document. FAR clause 52.212-4 apply to this procurement and are included within the attached solicitation document. Additional requirements are listed within the attached solicitation document. The Defense Priorities and Allocations System (DPAS) does not apply to this acquisition. Technical questions on this solicitation are due via e-mail only to Erica Miller, Contract Specialist, at erica.miller5@va.gov no later than 05:00pm Central Standard Time (CST), 09-10-2026. Quotes are due to the Contracting Office by 06:00am CST, 09-15-2026. Quotes are required to be emailed to erica.miller5@va.gov prior to the solicitation closing date and time. Contact Erica Miller, Contract Specialist, at erica.miller5@va.gov for information regarding the solicitation.

Įranga ir profesionaliu jos veikimo valdymu rūpinasi Paslaugų teikėjas.

description: Die DB InfraGO AG plant die Generalsanierung der Strecke Fulda-Hanau Kinzigtal. Für die bauliche Realisierung ist eine 5-monatige Totalsperrung ab dem 13.08.2027 vorgesehen. Im Schlüchtener Tunnel werden Signalum- und neubauten vorgenommen, um das Ausrüstungszielbild eines lückenlosen ESTW-Betriebs (ETCS ready) zwischen Hanau bis Fulda zu erreichen. Die Investitionssumme für dieses Projekt wird mit EUR 1,397 Mrd. veranschlagt. Hiervon sind bereits ca. EUR 83,276 Mio. über einen bestehenden Vertrag abgerechnet worden. Der hier neu ausgeschriebene Versicherungsvertrag wird den bestehenden Vertrag ablösen. Es wird mit einer derzeit geplanten Bauzeit bis zum 04.02.2028 gerechnet. Der Versicherungsvertrag beginnt nach Beendigung des Ausschreibungsverfahrens mit dem Datum des Zuschlages im Anschluss an eine derzeit bestehende Vorlaufdeckung. (Typ M) In der Haftpflichtversicherung beträgt die Deckungssumme je Schadenfall EUR 25.000.000 pauschal für Personen-, Sach- und Vermögensschäden, einschließlich der Leistungen aus der Umwelthaftpflichtversicherung. In der Planungshaftpflichtversicherung steht eine separate Deckungssumme je Schadenfall von EUR 10.000.000 pauschal für Sach- und Vermögensschäden zur Verfügung. Die vorgenannten Summen sind dreifach maximiert. Die Extendend Maintenance im Teil Bauleistungs- und Montageversicherung beträgt 42 Monate. Die Nachhaftung beträgt in der Haftpflichtversicherung 10 Jahre, in der Umwelt-haftpflicht- und Umweltschadenversicherung 5 Jahre. Der generelle Selbstbehalt beträgt mindestens EUR 25.000. Für Personenschäden entfällt der Selbstbehalt. In der Planungshaftpflichtversicherung ist die erweiterte Planungsdeckung eingeschlossen. Im Rahmen der erweiterten Planungsdeckung beträgt der Selbstbehalt EUR 100.000.

title: Design-Build of a Tier II Mobile Command Post Vehicle (MCPV) Trailer
description: Amendment 0002 The purpose for Amendment 0002 is to change the time offers are due from 2 p.m. Eastern Time (ET) to 8 a.m. ET and the due date to September 15th, 2026. Any submission received after September 15th, 2026 at 8 a.m Eastern Time (ET) will not be eligible for award. The Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI) intends to award a single-award, Firm-Fixed-Price, Indefinite-Delivery/Indefinite-Quantity (IDIQ) contract for Tier II Mobile Command Post Vehicle (MCPV) systems. The purpose of this acquisition is to establish a contract vehicle for the design, engineering, manufacturing, integration, testing, and production of trailer-based mobile command post systems capable of supporting FBI command, control, communications, and computer (C4) operations. The Tier II MCPV requirement consists of a custom-integrated gooseneck trailer system and, when ordered, a compatible Class 4 prime hauler vehicle. The MCPV Trailer shall provide a mobile operational environment supporting mission communications, networking, workspace, power generation and distribution, environmental control, equipment racks, audio/visual capabilities, RF and satellite connectivity provisions, security systems, and integration of Government-furnished and Contractor-furnished mission equipment. The contract will include a First Article requirement. The Contractor shall design, manufacture, integrate, test, and obtain Government approval of an initial MCPV Trailer configuration prior to production quantities. The approved First Article configuration will establish the production baseline for subsequent MCPV Trailer systems. The Government anticipates ordering approximately thirteen (13) MCPV trailer systems and associated prime hauler vehicles over the contract ordering period; however, the Government guarantees only the minimum contract obligation identified in the solicitation. The maximum contract value shall not exceed $15,000,000.00.

title: Design-Build of a Tier II Mobile Command Post Vehicle (MCPV) Trailer
description: Amendment 0003 Please refer to Q and A_Response for the Government's responses and Attachment_4_Price_Template_REV1. Amendment 0002 The purpose for Amendment 0002 is to change the time offers are due from 2 p.m. Eastern Time (ET) to 8 a.m. ET and the due date to September 15th, 2026. Any submission received after September 15th, 2026 at 8 a.m Eastern Time (ET) will not be eligible for award. The Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI) intends to award a single-award, Firm-Fixed-Price, Indefinite-Delivery/Indefinite-Quantity (IDIQ) contract for Tier II Mobile Command Post Vehicle (MCPV) systems. The purpose of this acquisition is to establish a contract vehicle for the design, engineering, manufacturing, integration, testing, and production of trailer-based mobile command post systems capable of supporting FBI command, control, communications, and computer (C4) operations. The Tier II MCPV requirement consists of a custom-integrated gooseneck trailer system and, when ordered, a compatible Class 4 prime hauler vehicle. The MCPV Trailer shall provide a mobile operational environment supporting mission communications, networking, workspace, power generation and distribution, environmental control, equipment racks, audio/visual capabilities, RF and satellite connectivity provisions, security systems, and integration of Government-furnished and Contractor-furnished mission equipment. The contract will include a First Article requirement. The Contractor shall design, manufacture, integrate, test, and obtain Government approval of an initial MCPV Trailer configuration prior to production quantities. The approved First Article configuration will establish the production baseline for subsequent MCPV Trailer systems. The Government anticipates ordering approximately thirteen (13) MCPV trailer systems and associated prime hauler vehicles over the contract ordering period; however, the Government guarantees only the minimum contract obligation identified in the solicitation. The maximum contract value shall not exceed $15,000,000.00.

title: 520-2609 – E Range & F Range Duct Sewer Main Relining
description: 520-2609 E Range & F Range Duct Sewer Main Relining This requirement is for: The Correctional Service of Canada, Saskatchewan Penitentiary in Prince Albert, Saskatchewan. Trade agreement: Canadian Free Trade Agreement (CFTA). Policy on Reciprocal Procurement: This solicitation is open only to Canadian suppliers. Competitive Procurement Strategy: lowest priced compliant bid. Set-aside under the Procurement Strategy for Indigenous Business: This procurement is not subject to any set-asides for Indigenous Suppliers. Comprehensive Land Claim Agreement: This procurement is not subject to a Comprehensive Land Claims Agreement. Security Requirements: This contract does not include security requirements. Nature of Requirements: The following is a summary of the statement of work for this requirement. The Correctional Service Canada has a requirement to rehabilitate the existing sanitary sewer main within E & F ducts using cured in place pipe (CIPP) technology. Objectives: To rehabilitate the existing sanitary sewer main within E & F ducts using cured in place pipe (CIPP) technology to restore structural integrity, eliminate infiltration and exfiltration, and extend service life with minimal disruption to operations. Deliverables: the Contractor must keep site Disruptions (including, but not limited to noise, dust and smells) to a minimum. The Contractor must communicate all anticipated disruption to the Project Authority ahead to allow CSC to distribute communications. 1. Schedule: a. The Contractor must perform the work during Saskatchewan Penitentiary’s regular business hours from Monday – Friday, 08:00 – 16:00 b. The Contractor must provide a Detailed Schedule upon contract award. 2. While on site, the contractor and sub-contractors must cooperate fully with operational staff and conform to all security requirements. 3. The Contractor must provide Operation and Maintenance (O&M) Manuals, that include the following information as a minimum: a. Manufacturer product data b. Maintenance Schedule c. Warranty information 4. The Contractor must submit the operations and maintenance (O&M) manuals for CSC’s acceptance as a condition of Substantial Completion. 5. The Contractor must provide the following Drawings and Attachments: a. Pre and post installation closed-circuit television (CCTV) video recordings. b. Installation logs, curing records, quality assurance and quality control (QA/QC) documentation. c. As-built records showing lined sections and reinstated connections. d. Detailed progress pictures before and after cleaning. e. Detailed progress pictures after completion. f. Final CCTV Inspection with written acceptance by the Project Authority. Any conditions for participation of suppliers not specified in solicitation documentation: None. Estimated quantity of commodity: See solicitation document statement of work and basis of payment. Duration of Contract and Time Frame for Delivery: Construction Time: The Contractor must perform and complete the Work within twenty-six (26) weeks.

description: NELSON VDES- Base Stations Fintraffic Vessel Traffic Services Ltd. (VTS) is launching a tendering procedure for the procurement of VDES base stations and related shore-side system components and services for Fintraffic’s maritime traffic management environment. The procurement concerns the supply of VDES base stations, including related equipment and services necessary for the delivery and implementation of the solution. The scope may include, among other things, VDES base stations with GNSS receivers, cabling and lightning protection, a VDES shore system management solution, testing and commissioning, documentation, instructions and manuals, training of operators and technicians, and support and maintenance after the warranty period. The solution and related services shall support the implementation, management, monitoring and operation of the VDES base station system in accordance with the requirements set out in the procurement documents. title: FORNITURA DI FERRAMENTA COMPRENSIVO DI TRASPORTO (CONSEGNA) PER PRODUZIONI TELEVISIVE DEL CPTV DI ROMA, MILANO, TORINO E NAPOLI
description: Accordo Quadro con un unico operatore ai sensi dell’art. 59 comma 3 del Codice avente ad oggetto la fornitura di ferramenta comprensiva di trasporto (consegna) per produzioni televisive del CPTV di Roma, Milano, Torino e Napoli. La lista del materiale oggetto di fornitura è riportata nel dettaglio all'interno della documentazione di gara. La fornitura è comprensiva delle schede tecniche e di sicurezza dei materiali forniti e delle dichiarazioni di conformità rilasciate dal produttore a norma di legge nonchè di ogni onere relativo al trasporto e recapito ad uno dei magazzini Rai di Roma, Milano, Napoli o Torino. Rai stipulerà con l’aggiudicatario un Accordo Quadro della durata di 36 mesi decorrenti dalla data di sottoscrizione dell’accordo quadro, per effetto del quale l’affidatario si obbligherà ad eseguire le prestazioni oggetto dell’appalto, secondo le specifiche tecniche oggetto del Capitolato ai prezzi unitari offerti. I documenti di gara conterranno le seguenti previsioni ai sensi dell'art. 120, comma 1, lett. a) del Codice: - qualora l'importo contrattuale non dovesse essere esaurito alla scadenza del termine di durata contrattuale, la durata dell’ accordo quadro potrà essere estesa per il tempo necessario all’utilizzo dell’intero importo contrattuale (fermo restando la natura non vincolante delle prestazioni); - in caso di necessità nel corso della vigenza contrattuale, Rai si riserva di modificare ai sensi dell’art. 120 comma1 lett. a) del Codice di modificare/compensare la capienza dimensionale di ciascuna voce contrattuale. In particolare, Rai, a seconda di esigenze specifiche, dovute al maggior impiego di una voce contrattuale rispetto ad un’altra potrà operare la riduzione della voce meno utilizzata in favore dell’aumento della voce più utilizzata, fermo restando il valore complessivo dell’ accordo quadro; - la facoltà di richiedere all’appaltatore, nel corso della durata dell’accordo quadro, qualora i si renda necessario un aumento o una diminuzione delle prestazioni fino a concorrenza del quinto dell'importo del contratto pari ad euro 63.480, anche ai sensi dell’art. 120, comma 9, del Codice, di imporre all'appaltatore l’esecuzione alle condizioni originariamente previste. In tal caso l'appaltatore non può fare valere il diritto alla risoluzione dell’accordo quadro. In casi eccezionali, al verificarsi delle condizioni indicate all’art. 120 comma 11 del Codice, la durata dell’Accordo Quadro anche se prorogata nei termini sopra descritti ma ancora in corso di esecuzione, potrà essere ulteriormente prorogata per il tempo strettamente necessario alla conclusione della procedura di individuazione del nuovo contraente (ferma restando la natura non vincolante dell’importo residuo nei termini sopra espressi). In tal caso l’appaltatore sarà tenuto all’esecuzione delle prestazioni oggetto dell’accordo quadro agli stessi prezzi, patti e condizioni previsti nel contratto.

description: The aim of the service is to provide short-term, non-clinical support to young people who may be experiencing anxiety, low mood, isolation or other issues, and who may be disengaged from education and/or the community. title: Echodyne EchoShield Radar System
description: Published Q&A on 10 September 2026 Amendment 0001: The purpose of this amendment is to update the salient characteristics and Combo to reflect new CLIN. Amendment 0002: The purpose of this amendment is to extended the solicitation end date. The EchoShield is a software-defined, cognitive 4D pulse-Doppler radar operating in the Ku-band (15.4 to 16.6 GHz) that utilizes Echodyne's proprietary Metamaterials Electronically Steerable Antenna (MESA) technology This low size, weight, and power (low-SWaP) system is designed for multi-domain, multi-mission operations, offering a wide field of view (130� azimuth by 90� elevation) and an industry-leading angular tracking accuracy of less than 0.5�. Built to military standards (MIL-STD-810H), the ruggedized, IP67-rated unit can track over 1,000 objects simultaneously and output high-precision data to direct optical sensors and mitigation effectors. Highly versatile and customizable via software waveforms, the EchoShield supports diverse missions --including counter-UAS, ground dismount and vehicle tracking, coastal perimeter security, and on-the-move mobile operations. The 57 RQS requests acquisition of four (4) echodyne echoshield radars, 4 units of EchoShield software uprates and technical support, amd the echodyne rapid deployment kit.

title: Preventive maintenance and repairs of medical equipment
description: This requirement is for: The Correctional Service of Canada, all CSC institutions in the Quebec Region. Trade agreement: Canadian Free Trade Agreement (CFTA), Canada Korea Trade Agreement (CKTA), Canada free trade agreements with Chile/Colombia/Honduras/Panama, Canada-Peru Free Trade Agreement, Canada-European Union Comprehensive Economic and Trade Agreement (CETA). Policy on Reciprocal Procurement: This solicitation is open only to Canadian suppliers and to Suppliers of an applicable trading partner. Competitive Procurement Strategy: lowest priced compliant bid. Set-aside under the Procurement Strategy for Indigenous Business: This procurement is not subject to any set-asides for Indigenous Suppliers. Comprehensive Land Claim Agreement: This procurement is not subject to a Comprehensive Land Claims Agreement. Security Requirements: This contract does not include security requirements. Nature of Requirements: The following is a summary of the statement of work for this requirement. The Correctional Service Canada (CSC) requires services for the preventive maintenance and repair of medical equipment at all CSC institutions in the Quebec region. This service is necessary to comply with Accreditation Canada's Required Safety Practices as well as manufacturers' recommendations, to ensure that the equipment is functional and effective throughout its lifespan. They also contribute to providing safe and secure health services to clients. Objectives: The Contractor must provide preventive maintenance and repair services for medical equipment by supplying the qualified labour, expertise, products, accessories, tools, equipment, and transportation to carry out the work. Deliverables: The Contractor must: a) Provide a complete list as well as a comprehensive visit report on all equipment inspected according to Accreditation Canada criteria after each service, within 60 days. The visit report must include: i. one report per device inspected; ii. the calibration certificate; iii. for devices requiring repair, a document detailing the necessary repairs. b) Provide a complete list of tools and equipment used during the work. Submit the list for review before each visit. Keep an updated list of tools and equipment throughout the work. c) Provide one invoice per institution, once the project manager has approved the submitted reports. Any conditions for participation of suppliers not specified in solicitation documentation: none. Estimated quantity of commodity: see solicitation document statement of work and basis of payment. Duration of Contract and Time Frame for Delivery: Period of the Contract: The Work is to be performed during the period of April 1, 2027 to March 31, 2029 with the option to renew for two (2) additional one-year periods. title: International Construction Works 5 international regions (Africa/Sub Saharan, Asia/Pacific, Europe, Middle East/Maghreb, and the Americas)
description: His Majesty the King in right of Canada, represented by the Minister of Foreign Affairs, and the Department of Foreign Affairs, Trade and Development (DFATD), is inviting suppliers with experience in the delivery of construction services to submit a Response to qualify for the planned work for the various construction projects. The scope of this solicitation covers international construction works across 5 designated regions: Africa/Sub-Saharan, Asia-Pacific, Europe, the Middle East/Maghreb, and the Americas. These regions reflect the geographical distribution of current and anticipated projects and are intended to facilitate region-specific expertise, responsiveness, and delivery capacity. The countries for each region are listed in Annex E, Countries by Region. This list is provided for information only and may change during the contract period. Bidders must be able to operate in the countries within the region(s) for which they submit a proposal. Work under this contract will involve the demolition, construction and fit-out of office spaces located within Government of Canada’s international portfolio, abroad. The fit-out and construction of these spaces will adhere to the drawings and specifications provided and must meet the quality standards established by DFATD and its representatives to ensure the requisite performance standards are met or surpassed. Work will also have a provision for limited local/regional Structural/ Mechanical and Electrical Engineering design services. Region Identification Requirement: Bidders are invited to submit proposals for 1 region, multiple regions, or all 5 regions, based on their demonstrated capabilities, experience, and operational presence.

title: Pavilion Design and Fabrication Services - at GULFOOD 2027
description: Agriculture & Agri-Food Canada (AAFC), is seeking proposals for Pavilion Design and Fabrication services at GULFOOD 2027. AAFC is organizing the Canada Pavilion at GULFOOD 2027, which will be held at the Dubai World Trade Center and the Dubai Exposition Center, Expo City, in Dubai, UAE from March 15 to 19, 2027. The Canada Pavilion will host a number of Canadian agri-food companies, associations, and federal/provincial departments. GULFOOD is the world's largest annual food and hospitality show. Held in Dubai, UAE, the show attracts approximately 8,500 exhibitors participating from over 195 countries and 200,000 professional visitors. AAFC’s Canada Pavilion Program provides Canadian food exporters with the opportunity to raise awareness of their products and position themselves competitively via the use of the Canada Brand. The key attributes of the Canada Brand are quality, innovation, sustainability and diversity. Canada’s Pavilion design should aim to support the promotion of these attributes. Bids must include the following: 1. Executive Summary: A brief overview of the proposed concept and design, key milestones and timelines for delivery of the project, and overall outcomes to be achieved. 2. Design Concept: The bid will include a design layout for an 866 square metre (sq. m) Canada Pavilion spread across four halls at two separate venues. One (1) 33m x 6m stand (198 sq. m), one (1) 17m x 6m stand (102 sq. m) and one (1) 23m x 6m stand (138 sq. m) in the Rice, Pulses & Grains Hall (Expo City Dubai), one (1) 33m x 6m stand (198 sq.) and two (2) 3m x 13m stand (39 sq.) in the World Food Hall (Expo City Dubai), one (1) 12m x 8m stand (96 sq. m) in the Meat Hall (Dubai World Trade Centre), and one (1) 7m x 8m stand (56 sq. m) in the Dairy Hall (Dubai World Trade Centre). The design concept must leverage existing Canada Brand colour schemes, logos, taglines and make the Canada Pavilion stand out from other countries/competitors on the show floor. The design concept must showcase the attributes associated to the Canada Brand (quality, sustainability, innovation and diversity as they apply to the agriculture and food sector) and allow the Canada Pavilion to stand out from other countries/competitors on the show floor. The design must allow for a combination of enclosed and open concept booth layouts to accommodate the needs of both individual companies as well as larger group exhibitors. The design and layout of the pavilion should be flexible to accommodate changes from year-to-year. The design should include sustainable materials that can be reused throughout the duration of the contract. 3. Project Management for Services: Provide a detailed description of the approach, human resources required for each service and detailed, comprehensive timelines including milestones for planning and interactions with Show Authority, AAFC and exhibitors as well as fabrication and delivery schedule. 4. Contingency Plan: Describe potential challenges, constraints or unexpected situations and/or major difficulties that may arise during the course of the project including staffing issues and provide mitigating measures and approaches to address these. 5. Summary/Recommendation: Provide any additional information and/or recommendations that are essential to the project.
